orthodontics.title: Aligners & braces
orthodontics.description: Clear aligners and ceramic braces. See your result in 3D before treatment even begins.

aesthetics.title: Veneers & aesthetics
aesthetics.description: Ceramic veneers and whitening. Your smile is designed digitally with Digital Smile Design.

hygiene.title: Hygiene
hygiene.description: Professional Air Flow and ultrasonic cleaning. Recommended every 6 months.

kids.title: Pediatric dentistry
kids.description: Gentle, playful treatment. The first visit is a meet-and-greet with no instruments.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Didn't find an answer? Message us on WhatsApp or Telegram — we reply within 15 minutes.

pain.a: We use modern anaesthetics and computer-controlled anaesthesia. Most patients don't even feel the injection.

price.q: Can the price change during treatment?
price.a: No. After diagnostics we prepare a plan with an estimate, and the price is fixed in your contract.

installments.a: Yes, interest-free installments for up to 12 months on implants, aligners and veneers.

warranty.a: From 1 year on fillings up to 10 years on implants and crowns with regular check-ups.

tourists.q: I live abroad. Can I complete treatment in one trip?
tourists.a: Yes. Send us your X-rays in advance and we'll build a plan and schedule around your travel dates.

kids.q: At what age should I bring my child?
kids.a: We recommend the first preventive check-up at 2–3 years old, once the baby teeth have come in.
